BatchDefaults.description: Values every query starts from; a query's own values win.

command.description: Query command used by queries without one (default: search).

BatchDefaults.title: BatchDefaults

BatchOptions.description: How the batch runs. The CLI flags override these values.

wait.description: Wait for each result (otherwise rows are only submitted: status 'queued').
wait.title: Wait

reuse.description: Identical query already answered: 'ask' = reuse it, asking before downloading again when the answer is stale (no terminal = no); 'reuse' = always reuse the previous answer; 'force' = always send a new request (possibly paid).
reuse.title: Reuse

max_in_flight.description: Rows handled at once. The service has one portal session, so 1 is the safe default.
max_in_flight.title: Max In Flight

retries.description: Extra attempts for a row that fails with a transient error or status 'error'.
retries.title: Retries

retry_delay.description: Seconds before the first retry; doubles on each further retry.
retry_delay.title: Retry Delay

poll_timeout.description: Seconds to wait for one request before giving up (client default). A CAPTCHA row needs enough time for a human to type it.
poll_timeout.title: Poll Timeout

on_error.description: 'stop' = after the first failed row, do not start the others (they stay pending).
on_error.title: On Error

output_dir.description: Folder for one JSON per row (batch_NNNN_<command>.json) and the journal (resume).
output_dir.title: Output Dir

BatchOptions.title: BatchOptions

id.description: Unique id, used by the journal and for resume. Default: q0001, q0002, ...
id.title: Id

params.description: Parameters of the command (same names as its CLI options). Numbers and booleans are accepted; null removes a value inherited from defaults.params.
params.title: Params

enabled.description: false = keep the query in the file but do not run it.
enabled.title: Enabled

metadata.description: Free-form notes copied to the result (source files, reason, ...). Not sent.
metadata.title: Metadata

name.description: Label of the batch, copied to the report.
name.title: Name
